scope_note: Selected rolling 90-day search-term export. This is not a full-account export and not one week of spend. Repeated runs may cover overlapping dates; never add their spend together.

review_patterns.reason: Free receptionist searches may still be a business buyer evaluating a trial. Review the landing page and lead quality before excluding this exact query.
A free API query can be developer evaluation intent. Inspect activation and later payment evidence; zero CRM leads alone does not prove it is irrelevant.

negative_patterns.reason: The query expresses job-seeker intent rather than intent to buy the advertised product.

negative_patterns.pattern: \bvoice (?:generator|changer)\b|\btext to speech online free\b|\bchatgpt voice mode\b
negative_patterns.reason: The query names a consumer voice tool or consumer ChatGPT feature rather than a business phone-agent platform.
The query appears to be navigation or support for an existing competitor user. Keep competitor pricing and alternative searches eligible.
The query asks for the consumer ChatGPT service and does not express API or developer intent.
